label: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Network Engineer

patch.objective: Configuring restricted Google Cloud services with VPC Service Controls perimeters

sources.cite: Google Cloud, Professional Cloud Network Engineer certification exam guide (April 2026): designing and planning a VPC network ~21%, VPC network implementation ~20%, managed network services ~16%, hybrid and multicloud interconnectivity ~16%, network operations ~14%, cloud network security ~13%
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Bullet quoted there under 1.1: 'Planning for Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) networking (e.g., secondary ranges, scale potential based on IP address space'. The objective wording is the course seed's. (read for this round by an earlier pass on 2026-11-17)

sources.cite: Google Codelabs, 'VPC Service Controls Basic Tutorial II - Troubleshooting Egress Violation'
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: a denied request's audit log shows the violation reason, an egressViolations entry (request leaving the perimeter), the source project, the targetResource project and the principalEmail, with a vpcServiceControlsUniqueId to filter; the fix is an egress rule applied with --set-egress-policies whose egressFrom names the identities and whose egressTo names serviceName storage.googleapis.com, method selectors and the target project's resources; IAM is a separate check. The violation reason code and the dry-run output in the case are authored renderings (the VPC Service Controls troubleshooting pages were not read).
